授業科目の概要.対象学部等: 生物資源環境科学府　Graduate School of Bioresource and Bioenvironment Sciences
授業科目の概要.曜日時限: 秋学期 木曜日 ３時限
授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項: Experts in genetics, biochemistry, and bioinformatics will lecture on the basics of each of these fields, assign tasks in each lecture session, and students will make presentations on these tasks. In each lecture session, a task is assigned, and students are required to give a presentation on the task. The instructor gives an explanation of these tasks, and a presentation is given in the final session. In this lecture, students will practice data analysis of genome decoding, transcripts, translation products, etc. using COVID19 as a subject.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 本講義は修士論文作成のために必要な生物学、生化学、遺伝学、バイオテクノロジーの基礎知識を教授する。また近年、進化を続ける農学生命科学に関する最新の実験手法などについても紹介する。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: This course provides the basic knowledge of biology, biochemistry, genetics, and biotechnology necessary to write a master's thesis. It also introduces the latest experimental methods in agricultural life sciences, which have been evolving in recent years.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Gene, transcription, translation, central dogma, protein, genome, transcriptome, proteome, bioinformatics, next generation sequencing, BLAST, annotation, structure prediction
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件:
Since this course is a graduate course on life sciences, students are required to have taken undergraduate courses in molecular biology, biochemistry, genetics, and information science and have sufficient knowledge of these subjects.
Since this lecture is about life science in graduate school, it is desirable that students have taken biology, biochemistry, and genetics at undergraduate level.
